newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian Air orders four Airbus A330-200.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Air orders four Airbus A330-200.

text.p: Austrian flag carrier Austrian Airlines said on Thursday it had placed a firm order for four Airbus A330-200 long range aircraft worth some four billion schillings ($365.1 million).
It said the first plane was expected to be delivered in August 1998, and the second one at the beginning of 1999. ($ = 10.95 Austrian Schillings)
In a statement, the part-state owned carrier said the new A330s would replace its existing fleet of A310s by 2000, when the final two A330s would be delivered.
"Austrian Airlines are investing into the future of long-range traffic," it said.
